mainEntity.name: What is the process for an accessible bathroom remodel with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process with Hometelligent Inc. begins with an initial consultation to assess your needs and the existing bathroom space. We then provide a detailed design proposal and estimate, followed by assistance with material selection and permit acquisition if required. Once approvals are in place, our team schedules and executes the remodel, focusing on minimizing disruption and ensuring quality craftsmanship. The final step involves a walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The remodel process includes consultation, design proposal, material selection, permit help, construction, and a final walkthrough. This ensures your needs are met with quality craftsmanship.
